title: NBN POI 4ROT (Rockhampton) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Scheduled maintenance will move nbn services off the Rockhampton (4ROT) POI to a new router. Customers with services on this POI may experience brief interruptions during the window: 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 5 August 2026. Our team will monitor and restore services as works complete.

updates.content: We will be performing planned maintenance on our network affecting some nbn services delivered via the Rockhampton (4ROT) POI. The maintenance window is from 12:00 AM to 2:00 AM AEST on 5 August 2026. During this time, services may briefly drop as we move connections to a new router. We will work to keep any interruption as short as possible and will monitor throughout the window.
